# PR type
- [x] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Fixes #10435

## Summary

`encode_sample()` now resolves the rollout response prefix through
`get_response_prefix_ids()`, which calls `template._get_response_prefix()`. The local
`_FakeTemplate` in `tests/utils/test_opsd_teacher_images.py` predates that call, so four
teacher-image tests fail on `main` with:

```text
AttributeError: '_FakeTemplate' object has no attribute '_get_response_prefix'
```

This adds the missing hook to the fake template and returns `None`, matching a template without a
custom response prefix. Production code is unchanged.

## Verification

```bash
# Before (main)
python -m pytest tests/utils/test_opsd_teacher_images.py -q
# 4 failed, 5 passed

# After
python -m pytest tests/utils/test_opsd_teacher_images.py -q
# 9 passed

# Lint/format for the changed file
pre-commit run --files tests/utils/test_opsd_teacher_images.py
# all hooks passed
```

The real Qwen2-VL test in this file also passed locally (the environment needed `qwen_vl_utils`
installed, which is already a model dependency in CI).

## GPU validation

Not applicable: this is a test-fixture fix only; the tests are CPU tests.
